fixes.code:
# TripVerse

> Agentic 3D travel-planning universe that visualizes and dynamically replans your trip.

## Pages
- [TripVerse — 3D Travel Universe](https://tripverse-0.vercel.app/)
fixes.note: Save as /llms.txt at your site root. Low measured impact today, so do it after the fixes above.
fixes.title: Add an llms.txt map (low impact)

fixes.note: Publish at https://tripverse-0.vercel.app/bc6442da67e2ece678b7eaa5d08ce31b.txt. Keep this key for future URL submissions. IndexNow announces changes to supporting search engines; it does not guarantee indexing.
fixes.title: Optional: add an IndexNow key file

notes: Not blocked for an AI search user agent. Edge networks verify real crawlers by IP, so this cannot prove access.

evidence.backend: Supabase project https://eidaueavbiodoavhiuzq.supabase.co and public client key in the page or its own scripts. This is normal public configuration; it does not establish a security issue or prove that access rules are correct.

report.summary: The journey stopped early with 10 browser actions with recorded outcomes. Journey completion was not confirmed, and no observed journey failure was established. Automated checks produced 17 findings; review their evidence and coverage separately.

findings.fix: Reduce render-blocking work and optimize the largest above-the-fold element.
findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint is slow
findings.detail: A single browser visit observed LCP at 8268 ms; the good threshold is 2500 ms. This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.

findings.fix: Reserve space for images, embeds and dynamic content before they load.
findings.title: Layout shifts exceed the Core Web Vitals target
findings.detail: A single browser visit observed CLS at 1.894; the good threshold is 0.1 . This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.

findings.fix: Prerender the homepage (static generation or server rendering), or at least put a real h1, description and a short paragraph about the product in index.html.
findings.title: Homepage content only appears after JavaScript runs
findings.detail: The server sends 1536 bytes of HTML with 0 characters of visible text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript, so ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity see an empty page. Link previews on WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Slack do too. Google runs JavaScript but indexes it later.

findings.fix: Return a 404 status for unknown paths: serve a real 404 page, and rewrite only your app's known routes to index.html.
findings.title: Missing pages return 200
findings.detail: A made-up address (/walkthru-missing-page-check) answered 200 with a page instead of 404. Search engines treat these as soft 404s, and broken links look like working pages to visitors and crawlers.

findings.fix: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage, plus SoftwareApplication or Product where you describe the product.
findings.title: No structured data
findings.detail: Your pages have no JSON-LD. Structured data tells AI assistants exactly what your product is, who makes it and what it costs.

findings.fix: Start with default-src 'self' and add sources as needed; use report-only first.
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: Without a CSP, any injected script runs with full access to the page.

findings.fix: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
findings.title: Page can be framed
findings.detail: Another site can embed this page and trick users into clicking (clickjacking).

findings.fix: Add one main heading that states what the page is about.
findings.title: No h1 heading
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: The page has no top-level heading. Advisory: a clear main heading helps visitors and screen-reader users find the topic; search engines also read prominent headings.

findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing at the preferred URL.
findings.title: No canonical link
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: Without a canonical URL, variants like ?utm= or trailing slashes can split ranking signals.

findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image meta tags.
findings.title: No Open Graph tags
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: Links shared on social apps will show no preview title or image.

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.detail: Crawlers fall back to defaults and cannot find your sitemap.

findings.fix: Generate /sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.
findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.detail: Search engines discover pages slower without a sitemap.

findings.fix: Add /llms.txt: an H1 with your name, a one-line > summary, then sections of links to your key pages.
findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.detail: llms.txt is a short Markdown map of your site for AI tools. It has low measured impact on AI search today, so fix the items above first.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /.well-known/ai.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /.well-known/ai.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /llms-full.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /llms-full.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.title: No X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: Browsers may sniff file types and run a text file as script.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Full URLs, including query strings, leak to every site you link to.
